SAP EAM

Intelligent asset management for the modern enterprise.

Founded 1972
Pricing Model Enterprise
Deployment Cloud / SaaS, On-Premise, Hybrid

Overview

SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) helps organizations manage the entire lifecycle of their physical assets. Deeply integrated with the SAP ERP ecosystem, it provides advanced predictive maintenance, real-time analytics, and comprehensive financial tracking for massive global operations.

  • IoT and Machine Learning Capabilities
